classification.difficultyReason: Part a is signposted Pythagoras. Part b needs a triangle area, a circle area from the diameter, a subtraction and the length multiplier. This is a routine chain with one representation change (diameter to radius, hole subtracted), and the scaffolding of part a is supplied.

content.prompt: Consider this isosceles triangular prism with a hole through the middle.

answer.worked:
The perpendicular height bisects the 16 cm base because the triangle is isosceles.
$$\begin{align*}y^2+8^2&=17^2\\y^2&=289-64=225\\y&=\sqrt{225}=15\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Hence, find the volume. Round your answer to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
The hole has radius $6\div2=3\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}V_{\text{prism}}&=\left(\frac12\times16\times15\right)\times40=4800\text{ cm}^3\\V_{\text{hole}}&=\pi(3)^2\times40=360\pi\text{ cm}^3\\V&=4800-360\pi\text{ cm}^3\\V&\approx3669.0\text{ cm}^3\end{align*}$$
